_comment: Communities/events publishing their data in OTE format. Add yours via PR or issue. Fields: name (required), kind (community|directory — what the entity IS), url, feed, logo (path or URL; falls back to initials), desc {en,es}, directory, consumes. Roles are not stored twice: a `feed` means it PUBLISHES (verified by the registration pipeline and re-measured daily by scripts/check-feeds.mjs), and `consumes` ("live" | "planned") means it also INGESTS other OTE feeds. That one is self-declared — nothing here can verify it — so intent is listed as intent: "planned" renders as coming soon and never counts as reach you already have.
